newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 3rd qtr steel output seen flat qtr/qtr -- MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan 3rd qtr steel output seen flat qtr/qtr -- MITI.

text.p: Japan's crude steel production in the third quarter ending in December is likely to remain flat against estimated output of 26.05 million tonnes in the July-September period, a Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) official said on Monday.
The official said he expected growth to be flat because Japan's car makers were expected to slow their output in the second and third quarters of this fiscal year, which ends in March 1998.

The official said domestic steel demand from the manufacturing sector in the second quarter was expected to fall by two percent from the previous quarter, also because of the anticipated slowdown in car production.

MITI said crude steel output in the April-June quarter was estimated at 26.7 million tonnes, up 7.6 percent from the same period the previous year, mainly because of increased demand from the car industry and the housing sector.
The official said crude steel output was certain to exceed 100 million tonnes for the whole fiscal year.
